dna.hero: The morning batch. The first screen belongs to one sweet, the dorayaki with tsubu-an, and to the shop's own words 毎朝炊く粒あん beside the name 架空菓庵. Quiet and close, like one sweet wrapped on a small counter (小さな店頭). The name and the sweet may overlap, stand vertically or sit off-centre if that makes the screen feel like this shop rather than a template.
dna.typography: A refined Mincho for the name and for the two acts the shop states itself, 毎朝炊く粒あん and 一つずつお包みしています, shown as its reasons 1 and 2 with large numerals in azuki. A calm Gothic at reading size for hours, days off, address and phone. Vertical or horizontal setting, mixed directions and strong size contrast are all open.
dna.palette: Kinari #F4EFE4 ground, sumi #2B2622 for all text, a slightly darker kinari band #E2D6C0 behind the two reasons, and azuki #6B2E2E used only for the numerals 1 and 2 and one hairline above the shop information. Azuki is the one colour taken from the shop, from the tsubu-an it cooks; the warmth comes from the sweet itself, not from added colour.
dna.product_visual: The dorayaki, cut to show the tsubu-an cooked that morning, is the one lead; 季節の上生菓子 is named in text, not pictured. If a generated image is allowed, use one image of that dorayaki, labelled as a concept image, never presented as a photograph of the shop. Without images, evoke the sweet with colour, layered shapes or inline SVG, never a photo imitation.
dna.section_rhythm: Follow the shop's own story: what is made (the dorayaki), how it is made (1 毎朝炊く粒あん, 2 一つずつお包みしています), what else is offered (季節の上生菓子), then when and where to buy it (hours with 売り切れ次第終了, days off 水曜・第2火曜, 名古屋市東区, phone), and a footer with the name and a short disclosure that this is a fictional shop (実在の店舗ではありません) and, where one is shown, that the image is a concept. Slow and generous; sections may overlap, shift off-axis or break the grid.
dna.navigation: Minimal text navigation to the reasons and to the shop information; no order, booking or cart wording, since the facts give none. The shop name stays readable at all times.
dna.mobile: Designed for the phone, not a shrunken desktop: the name and 毎朝炊く粒あん come before anything else, then the sweet, then reasons 1 and 2 stacked, then the shop information as label-above-value rows. Phone-specific layouts, vertical text and overlaps are welcome where they stay readable.
dna.implementation: One static page: semantic HTML and one stylesheet, rendered with no script and no external resource. Any CSS is welcome, including grid, absolute layering, writing-mode, clip-path, transforms, blend modes and inline SVG; nothing is limited to an implementation allowlist at this stage.

avoid: a generic hero with a centred headline and a button
an interchangeable card grid of products
prices, reviews, history, awards, people or any claim not in the facts
the placeholder menu names containing テスト, the placeholder station name and the full test address shown as real content
text, letters or logos inside a generated image
